Trust App

Your bank statement, turned into trust.

Discuss a deployment↗See how it works ↓

LisBon Trust App gives people a clear way to submit or connect financial evidence, see their Trust Profile and carry that context into credit-access journeys. It is the consumer surface of the LisBon financial infrastructure.

Who it is for

Lenders and institutions that need a clear financial-profile and credit-application journey for customers.

The system in action

See the work
change state.

01

The situation

A person or microbusiness has financial activity, but the evidence remains trapped in documents and difficult for institutions to understand.

02

The system at work

The app connects the user to governed financial evidence, a Trust Profile and the relevant next action without taking over the provider decision.

03

The outcome

The user sees what evidence was accepted, the trust context available and which action is possible next.

Agree what success looks like

Make the improvement visible.

Evidence completion; Trust Profile completion; eligible next steps; application progress; support demand.

Measures are agreed for each deployment. They are not guaranteed results.

From fit to deployment

Your work.
Your requirements.

We confirm the people, data, connections, authority and operating conditions required. Then we agree scope, delivery stages, acceptance checks and support.

Where the ready system does not fully fit, AlphaIT can engineer the missing connection or capability.

Credit providers retain their decisions and capital risk. Deployment is subject to applicable law, agreed policy and the authority of each participating institution.
